tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dam can mnyes pa'i mchod sprin bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// dpal 'brug pa rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// dam pa'i lugs yang dogs 'gag 'thug po'i ri// nag po chen po sprin drag gnag pa yis// mngon spyod gnam lcags phab nas rdul btags pas// phyin chad gong bu'i nga rgyal sus 'cha' nus// de phyir de gnyis byed pa'i pad+mo'i sde// legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od kyis rgyas byed 'di// sa spyod dpal bzang dad pa'i skyed tshal gyi// rgyan du 'os zhes 'brug pa'i dpyid kyis brtsams// dam can mnyes pa'i mchod sprin ge sar nas// mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal ye shes kyis mgon po/ snying rjes bdud la khro ba/ mun pa mun nag tu 'thibs pa/ bskal pa'i me ltar du 'bar ba/ dpal gyi chas su zhugs pa/ phyag bzhis be ta thod khrag ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams pa/ ha ha hi his gnam 'gengs pa/ sku'i lhun gyis bar snang khyab pa/ dpa' bo'i stabs kyis sa gzhi gnon pa/ bam brtsegs pa'i khri la 'gying ba/ yum tsa ṇ+ḍi ka dang sbyor ba/ lha mo brgyad kyis skyo ba bsangs pa/ legs ldan byar gdong blon por bzhugs pa/ ro langs brgya 'bod skad sgrog pa/ nag po stong las la zhugs pa/ sha za 'bum klad bshul 'brang ba/ ma mo sa yas gar bsgyur ba/ gnod sbyin khri mngag gzhug la chas pa/ zhing skyong mkha' 'gro pho nyar 'gyed pa/ dpal mgon bdun cus mdun bdar ba/ dregs pa can thams cad 'khor du spung pa/ dpal lha mo chen mo/ char gyi sprin ltar nag la/ ri rab ltar bongs che ba/ spyan gsum dmar po 'khyug pa/ khrag gi rgya mtsho hub kyis 'debs pa/ mi ro rengs pa khyur mid du za ba/ rgyan dang gos srid pa'i bdag po dang ma mo rnams kyis bstabs pa/ sa gsum gyi dbang po thams cad phyag 'tshal ba/ ral gri bhañdza/ shak+ti rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ laṅka'i bdag po'i dung mkhan la zhon pa/ 'phrin las thams cad thogs med du sgrub pa/ nad dang gdon gyi bdag mo/ gcer bu ral pa can gsum nang mir snang ba/

rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gros blon mor mdzad pa/ phra men brgyad dang sgo ma bzhi las la 'gyed pa/ srid pa mo rgyud thams cad bran mor hab sha ba/ gnod sbyin chen po rnam thos sras/ gser ltar ser ba/ zla ltar rgyas pa/ nyi ltar 'bar ba/ ri ltar brjid pa/ rdo rje'i go spras pa/ 'phrog byed sngon po la 'gying ba/ rgyal mtshan 'phyar zhing ne'u le 'dzin pa/ 'dzam bu gling pa la nyin bzhin 'dod dgu'i char thengs gsum du 'bebs pa/ rta bdag chen po brgyad dpa' zhing rtul phod pa/ bdud dang dgra la sdang ba/ dam tshig can la dung bas bka' nyan pa/ yan lag bzhi pa'i sde dpung chen po bcas pa/ sus kyang mi thub pa'i snyems 'chang ba/ gyad chen po'i rtsal ngom pa/ rgyal ba'i yas gam la gnas pa/ bstan pa spyi'i bya ra bgyid pa/ khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la/ dud pa'i khu ba lta bu/ stod srin po'i gzugs kyis bar snang khyab pa/ smad sbrul mjug 'khyil bas rgya mtsho gang ba/ lus thams cad mig gis gtams pa/ zhal dgus dgra srog hur thums su za ba/ zhags pa dang mda' 'phang ba/ sring mo bzhi dang rol ba/ gza' chen brgyad du sprul pa/ dus dang tshod la dbang byed pa/ lha srin sde brgyad bsdongs zlar bskul zhing 'ded pa/ sngon gyi sna thog ser glog gis 'dren pa/ rjes kyi shul me dpung dud pas mtshon pa/ dug gi rlangs pa 'thul ba/ phog 'gyel du gsod pa/ zhing skyong chen po mi'i lus la seng ge'i dbu/ ral pa gsig pas seng chung skar ltar rgyug pa/ za 'og ber gyon cing stag chas gyis sked bcings pa/ mdung dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ yid ltar mgyogs pa'i bdud kyi rta la zhon pa/ kha rag gling dgu'i bdag mdzad pa/ seng gdong dmar mo gzungs mar bsten pa/ 'jigs byed dus mtshan pho nyar bkol ba/ sde brgyad thams cad 'khor du khrid pa/ dgra la chas nas bzlog par dka' ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rtsal che ba/ drag shul gyi rngams mi bzad pa/ gzhan gyis mi thub pas thub dka'i mtshan 'dzin pa/

jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma/ mdzes pa dang rgyan gos bde sogs brgya byin gyi mchod par gsar pa dang mi phyed pa/ rdo rje dang tshe bum phyag tu bsrel ba seng ge dkar mo srab med du 'phyo ba la zhon pa/ sring mo bzhi zhabs 'bring bgyid pa/ sde brgyad kyi bu mo rang rang gi zlos gar 'bul ba'i dgung na bzhugs pa/ bod skyong rdo rje g.yu'i sgron ma/ gsang ba'i mtshan lhan cig skyes ma/ zhi zhing zhi ba/ dkar zhing dkar ba/ mdzes shing mdzes pa/ rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ lta ba'i mig sbrid pa/ snyan grags kyi rnga bo che phyag gis bskul ba/ rang dang phan tshun phyed dka' ba'i 'bangs mo 'bum gyis bskor ba/ gshin rje khrag mdog yab yum/ srin glang smyon pa la zhon pa/ drag po'i 'phong la byang ba/ ma ra khrag skyug gi dmag tshogs bsags pa/ gsod par rings pa/ za ba'i kha gdangs pa/ nyams pa'i gshed du 'bab pa/ dam tshig can gyi stangs 'dzin pa/ las kyi gshan pa dmar po/ go cha bgos pa/ zhub can gyi rta la dpa' skyen gyi rtsal/ glog ltar 'khyug pa rlung ltar 'phyo ba/ thog ltar 'bab pa/ khra ltar gzhung ba/ srog gcod kyi gshan pa thams cad 'khor du sdud pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros rang rang gnas pa'i sa nas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥhūm̐/ dag pa'i zhing khams chen po na// zhi ba nyag gcig min mi snang*// mi mjed la sogs 'jig rten na// zhi chags khro dang cher khros kun// de bas dad dang gdung shugs kyis// bar gcod bdud dgra bgegs byed dang*// log par 'dren rnams tshar gcod pa'i// dmag dpung chen por spyan 'dren no// mthu rtsal chen po'i nus stobs kyis// phun sum tshogs pa ma lus pa// bdag cag rnams kyi lag pa'i rtser// 'gugs pa'i lcags kyur gshegs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ dam can rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams rnams bdag gi smon lam dang bsod nams kyi stobs dang*/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs kyis 'byung bar gyur cig na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi sas+t+wā nāṃ/ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa man+ta swā hā/ 'jig rten phan par bzhed pa yis// 'jig rten tshul gzung khyod rnams la// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i phyir// 'jig rten gsum btud phyag bgyi'o// lha dbang rnams kyang phyag 'gul zhing*// mthong ba thams cad ha 'gal ba'i// spyan gzigs rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs ni// gyen du 'phyur bas khyed drung bkang*// 'ching snom gzigs skud myang ba'i ched// lha rdzas me tog spos dang ni// mar me byug pa zhal zas kyi// 'phreng ba khor yug bzhin du bskor// gser skyogs gser gyi ri bo'i khongs// mdangs dri ro bcud bsam yas pa'i// dpa' bo'i sman phud rol pa'i mtsho// gser kha g.yu yis brgyan pas mchod// g.yul ngor mtshon phog 'chir gtugs pa'i// lus la lang long skyes nas su// 'bab sar lbu ba gsob chags klung*// dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ chen por sbreng*// zhim zhim lha klu mi yi zas// bda' bda' bldag gzhib bca' ba'i sdes// brgyan brgyan byin rlabs ba ling ta// kha kha khā hi dam can tshogs// oṃ badz+ra ka wu ba ma hā kā la i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wi kā li kā li mahā kā li i daṃ sogs/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇa i/ oṃ rā hu la pak+ṣa me ke na i/ oṃ mahā kā la sidha mu kha i/ oṃ pañtsa ḍā ki? nī i daṃ/ oṃ badz+ra la la li li i/ oṃ ya ma rak+ta i/ oṃ ḍoṃ bhi rak+ta i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃs sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs bdun bdun gyis 'bul/ rgyas par spro na mngon rtogs re'i mthar/ khyed la gser kyi skyems/ dmar gyi chol/ ba ling gtor ma 'bul lo// gsol lo// mchod do// bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzad du gsol/

ces btags pas mchod// hūm̐/ drag po ji bzhin tshe yi rig 'dzin dang*// gdong bzhi ji bzhin legs phyogs dran skyen pa// 'dod lha ji bzhin thams cad las rgyal dang*// khyab 'jug ji bzhin skyu 'phrul rtsal che ba// brgya byin ji bzhin ci 'dod mod la 'grub// rnam sras ji bzhin bang mdzod phyug pa dang*// mi dbang ji bzhin sa gzhi bdag byed pa'i// phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bdag la stsol// ces dngos grub blangs te/ dam can rgya mtsho rnams la/ yon tan bsngags pa rgya mtsho sgrog pa'i dbyangs rab 'byams sems can gyi khams thams cad dang*/ chos kyi dbyings su grags pa 'jug par gyur cig na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi sas+t+wā nāṃ/ sarba tā saṃ ku su mi ta/ a dhi dzñā ra shi ra ni/ na mo stu te swā hā/ rkang pa brgyad pa dang*/ til mar ma 'don/ de nas/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor lo gsum// bde dngos gcig pur sdom mdzad pa// he ru ka dpal thugs rje'i gar// ye shes mgon po khyod la bstod// sku mthong khro rgyal rnams bred pas// 'dul 'os bdud dgra bgegs thams cad// snying ni shubs son lkog mar 'tshangs// sngags pa'i mod gsod khyod la bstod// gsung ngag gsang sngags yid skyob pa// ma rungs sems la rang las kyis// shub bur bzlas pa'ang dmod pa'i mtshon// rnon por lhung ba khyod la bstod// snying rje'i rol mo sgyu stabs la// sbyor dang sgrol ba'i stangs ka 'bul// pha rol 'joms la gtum che ba'i// zlos gar mdzad pa khyod la bstod// bh+yo/ gsang ba'i gnas kyi e gru gsum// 'byung lnga bskyed dang sdud pa'i gzhis// dang po'i mar shes lha dbang rnams// phyag 'tshal mchod pa khyod la bstod// khyod tshul gting zab rgya mtsho thugs// khyod brtan brling la ri rab g.yo// khyod mthu kun ster nor bu 'dzangs// de bas rtag tu khyod la bstod// 'khor gsum rtog pa'i pha rol gyi// shes rab gzugs 'dzin mngal gang du// rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum nas// 'jug pa'i re bas khyod la bstod// mi bsun bdud phyogs g.yag rgod sde// 'phong gis ror sgyur rngan chas pa// gyim shaṃ hor gyi gyad lta bu'i// rta brgyad kyis bskor khyod la bstod// mche ba'i mdun na nyi zla'i dbugs// thim bzhin phas rgol dgra bo yi// srog dbugs hur thum rbad gtong ba'i/

dregs pa'i dpon po khyod la bstod// seng ge'i sgra yis gnam 'phrogs zhing*// bdud rta brgyugs pas sa g.yo ba// phyag gis mtshon bsnun srog bcad ros// mdun 'jig skyi bung khyod la bstod// mdzes ma zla ba'i me long la// sgrib byed lha rdzas rtags kyis ci// 'dod dbang song dogs grub pa yi// brgya byin gyis bsgribs khyod la bstod// lhan cig skyes zhal pad+ma'i dpal// spyan 'bras mthing kha'i ut+pal la// chags pa'i zhags pas srid pa gsum// dam por 'ching ba khyod la bstod// laṅka'i mgrin pa gcig gtubs pas// rā ma ṇa khengs gnam lcags mdas// nyams pa'i mgrin pa kun bcad kyang*/ khengs pa med pa khyod la bstod// zhub can gshan pa'i sde dpung rnams// bstan la gnod pa gar 'dug par// jag par chas te srog dbugs ni// me ltar len pa khyod la bstod// dus bzang po la tsā ru'i ston mos kyang mchod par bya'o/// /sarba mad+ga laṃ/// /
